groups.name: NASDAQ SETUP
groups.label: 🟡 Mixed
groups.explanation:
Treasury yields remain the main pressure point, with the 2Y at 4.854% and the 10Y at 5.040%. Semiconductor momentum remains an important equity confirmation: SOXX has risen for 6 consecutive sessions. QQQ is +6.09% over five sessions and +4.29% versus its 20-day average. Brent is +0.16% at about $99.41, adding some inflation pressure.

The Nasdaq Setup is mixed/neutral (-8/100, deteriorating ↓). The tension is between persistent semiconductor momentum, supportive options positioning on the supportive side and elevated/rising Treasury yields, weaker intraday semiconductor leadership on the headwind side.

The important trigger is US10Y at 5.00%. A sustained break above roughly 5.00–5.05% while the 2Y remains near 4.85% would materially weaken the setup, especially if semiconductor leadership also deteriorates. A retreat in the 10Y with continued semiconductor strength would reinforce the positive setup.

consolidationRisk.explanation: Measures short-term market extension and pullback/consolidation risk, not Nasdaq direction. The score blends QQQ and SOX stretch, breadth, volatility and, when enough history is available, multi-day returns, moving-average extension and RSI. Model coverage shows how much of the full 100-point model currently has usable data.
